scope: The demo path, part four: the display-integrity rules the case names explicitly

checked.stale_markers: clean: every marker is published with a 0.3 s lifetime AND each published set begins with a DELETEALL marker (action=3, namespace 'clear'), so a vanished object is cleared by the next publication and by expiry - the case's rule about eternal markers of disappeared objects is satisfied twice over
checked.one_marker_per_point: clean: points travel as a PointCloud2 with a display cap (display_max_points 50000); markers carry the corridor and objects, not individual points
checked.headless: clean: RViz is launched only when the rviz argument is true, so the detector runs without a display
checked.timestamps: clean: each result row is written with the measurement timestamp, and the node's fixed frame change keeps message stamps on the same clock

verification_status: static read of tunnel_guard/visualization.py and tunnel_guard/ros_node.py; not exercised here (no ROS 2, no Docker daemon)
note: four passes of auditing this path found four defects and this clean result; the defects were the fixed frame, the input topic, the undeclared tf2 dependency and the build check that did not import the node - every one of them invisible to detection metrics and each capable of costing demonstration marks
